scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic. Finite numerical checks supplement but do not certify the all-dimensional statement. Closest published fixed-frame weight-rigidity result and standard spectral tools are credited; independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Local real Parseval-frame Gram projection theorem valid within a fixed nonzero sign chamber for \(m\ge4\). No global projection-constant maximum is inferred; no claim in dimension three, for complex frames, or for the full weighted Hessian outside the dimension-four flat family.
title: Local rigidity, exceptional flats, and weighted ascent for simplex-midpoint Parseval frames
